newsitem.title: FRANCE: Algeria to cut working hours to 40 a week.
newsitem.headline: Algeria to cut working hours to 40 a week.

text.p: The Algerian government adopted on Wednesday legislation to slash by four hours to 40 hours the basic working week in the North African country, the official Algerian news agency APS said.
Workers in government administrations and state-run companies as well as in private businesses would work 40 hours during five days a week, it said.
The government-appointed Transitional National Council, a sort of unelected parliament, is expected to vote the new work legisation within the next few months.
The cabinet also set up a special fund to pay salary loss for works and housing sector employees forced into temporary unemployement by bad weather.
The 120,000 strong housing sector workers' union had lobbied hard for the government to help pay workers who lost one third of their salaries because of bad weather.
